intro: IIPH Delhi and Starex University both sit in Gurgaon, and this page compares their recorded MSc fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

IIPH Delhi vs Starex University is not a single winner. IIPH Delhi is recorded as a public institute, while Starex University is private. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: IIPH Delhi vs Starex University for MSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIPH Delhi if you want a public MSc option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose Starex University if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.
IIPH Delhi lists Certificate Course on GIS Application in Public Health. Starex University lists Master of Science(M.Sc.) Botany.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records do not hold a quotable MSc programme fee for IIPH Delhi on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.

Our records list ₹75,000 a year as total fees for Starex University's Master of Science(M.Sc.) Botany. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for IIPH Delhi on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
In our records, Starex University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹11 lakh for Master of Science(M.Sc.) Botany. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for IIPH Delhi on this MSc page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Starex University on this MSc page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Gurgaon, Delhi NCR. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, IIPH Delhi is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
Starex University can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
